perOccurrenceAudit.basis: Stack-based overflow in xmlSnprintfElements. Vulnerable libxml2 code is present and loaded, so absence is not the basis. PostgreSQL core parser calls omit XML_PARSE_DTDVALID and xmlvalidate is unimplemented; shipped xml2 xml_valid is a well-formedness alias and XPath/XSLT paths omit DTD validation. Exact-image benign DTD tests show these shipped paths do not invoke the vulnerable validation diagnostic. The current superuser role and ability to install shipped xml2 were considered. Supports only the assessed core/shipped-extension paths; custom/native extensions or enabling DTD validation trigger reevaluation.

evidenceRefs.role: Core parser flags and xmlvalidate stub

perOccurrenceAudit.scopeLimit: Does not cover arbitrary custom/native extensions or future DTD validation use.

hashBindingValidation.semantics: SHA-256 is computed over committed Git-blob bytes at auditedHead, not raw checkout-normalized bytes.
hashBindingValidation.checkoutNote: core.autocrlf=true in the Windows worktree; text checkout bytes can therefore hash differently while the committed blob SHA-256 remains correct.
hashBindingValidation.validationMethod: Read each referenced blob at auditedHead using git cat-file blob, then SHA-256 the returned bytes.
